_note: Ground truth rebuilt from the source papers rather than from eyeball counts. Every value carries provenance: 'paper_stated' is quoted from the article text/tables and is the answer key; 'paper_derived' maps a reported clinical endpoint onto the figure's threshold (RECIST PR = bars beyond -30%, PD = bars beyond +20%); 'eyeball_unverified' has no published equivalent and must never be treated as truth. Hand labels made by counting thin bars on low-resolution JPEGs were the previous key and are recorded here where they disagree.
